item.text:
`test/orders.js` defines simple order helpers: `calcTotal` sums `price * qty`, `applyDiscount` applies `SAVE10` or `SAVE20`, `averageItemPrice` divides the calculated total by item count, and `formatOrder` renders item lines plus a formatted discounted total.

Bugs I see:

- [test/orders.js](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-cjlPAQ/test/orders.js:5): `calcTotal` uses `i <= items.length`, so the loop reads `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`. Accessing `.price` then throws. It should be `i < items.length`.
- [test/orders.js](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-cjlPAQ/test/orders.js:18): `averageItemPrice([])` divides by zero. Depending on desired behavior, it should return `0`, `NaN` intentionally, or throw a clearer error.
- Because `averageItemPrice` and `formatOrder` both call `calcTotal`, they also currently fail for any non-empty order due to the loop bug.
